Capital Gain.summary: One row per sale of an asset: sale and purchase dates, price, units, sale consideration, expenses, net sale consideration (INR) and cost of acquisition. A Total row ends the sheet.

validations.message: date of sale is missing
date of sale is not a real date like 12-Mar-24
date of sale is in the future
date of purchase is missing
date of purchase is not a real date like 12-May-23
date of purchase is in the future
price per unit is missing
price per unit is not a number
particulars is missing
type of asset is missing
currency is missing
no of units is not a number
sale consideration is not a number
expenses on transfer is not a number
net sale consideration is not a number
cost of acquisition is not a number

row_checks.sql: t.sl_no IS NULL OR (SELECT count(*) FROM {{tab:Capital Gain}} r WHERE r.sl_no = t.sl_no) > 1
row_checks.message: Sl No is missing or used more than once

row_checks.sql: t.price_per_unit IS NOT NULL AND t.no_of_units IS NOT NULL AND t.sale_consideration IS NOT NULL AND abs(t.price_per_unit*t.no_of_units-t.sale_consideration)>1
row_checks.message: sale consideration is not price per unit x units

row_checks.sql: t.sale_consideration IS NOT NULL AND t.expenses_on_transfer IS NOT NULL AND t.net_sale_consideration_inr IS NOT NULL AND abs(t.sale_consideration-t.expenses_on_transfer-t.net_sale_consideration_inr)>1
row_checks.message: net sale consideration is not sale consideration minus expenses

row_checks.sql: t.date_of_sale_dd_mmm_yy IS NOT NULL AND t.date_of_purchase_dd_mmm_yy IS NOT NULL AND t.date_of_sale_dd_mmm_yy<t.date_of_purchase_dd_mmm_yy
row_checks.message: sale date is before purchase date

measures.label: Sales with problems
measures.sql: count(*) FILTER (WHERE (date_of_sale_dd_mmm_yy IS NULL OR date_of_purchase_dd_mmm_yy IS NULL OR price_per_unit IS NULL OR abs(price_per_unit*no_of_units-sale_consideration)>1 OR abs(sale_consideration-expenses_on_transfer-net_sale_consideration_inr)>1 OR date_of_sale_dd_mmm_yy<date_of_purchase_dd_mmm_yy))

group_by.label: Financial year of sale (Apr-Mar)
group_by.sql: CASE WHEN date_of_sale_dd_mmm_yy IS NULL THEN 'No date' ELSE 'FY ' || CAST(year(date_of_sale_dd_mmm_yy) - CASE WHEN month(date_of_sale_dd_mmm_yy)<4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS VARCHAR) || '-' || lpad(CAST((year(date_of_sale_dd_mmm_yy) - CASE WHEN month(date_of_sale_dd_mmm_yy)<4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END + 1) % 100 AS VARCHAR),2,'0') END

group_by.label: Short or long term (over 12 months)
group_by.sql: CASE WHEN date_of_sale_dd_mmm_yy IS NULL OR date_of_purchase_dd_mmm_yy IS NULL THEN 'Unknown' WHEN date_of_sale_dd_mmm_yy > date_of_purchase_dd_mmm_yy + INTERVAL 12 MONTH THEN 'Long-term' ELSE 'Short-term' END

group_by.label: Problem found
group_by.sql: CASE WHEN date_of_sale_dd_mmm_yy IS NULL THEN 'Sale date missing or unreadable' WHEN date_of_purchase_dd_mmm_yy IS NULL THEN 'Purchase date missing or unreadable' WHEN date_of_sale_dd_mmm_yy<date_of_purchase_dd_mmm_yy THEN 'Sale before purchase' WHEN price_per_unit IS NULL THEN 'Price missing or not a number' WHEN abs(price_per_unit*no_of_units-sale_consideration)>1 THEN 'Sale consideration is not price x units' WHEN abs(sale_consideration-expenses_on_transfer-net_sale_consideration_inr)>1 THEN 'Net is not sale minus expenses' ELSE 'No problem' END

Travel Calendar.summary: One row per month entry: non-work/vacation days and work days in India. A Total row ends the sheet.

validations.message: month is missing
non-work days is not a number
non-work days is not between 0 and 31
work days is not a number
work days is not between 0 and 31

India Bank Account.summary: One row per bank account in India.

validations.message: IFS code is not 4 letters, 0, then 6 letters or digits
account number is not 9 or more digits
interest is not a number
closing balance is missing
refund account is not Y or N
